title: ml_inference backend layering, contracts, and duplicated validation
answers: Where are ml_inference contracts and serializers?
Which ml_inference module can other products import?
Where are gateway errors mapped to HTTP statuses?
body:
Layers: presentation/ → facade/ → logic/. tach exposes only backend.facade.* and backend.presentation.views.* externally.
- facade/contracts.py: frozen pydantic dataclasses DecisionRequest (MAX_QUESTIONS_PER_REQUEST=32 in __post_init__), DecisionQuestion (per-type criteria validation in __post_init__), NoulAnswer/ChoiceAnswer/ScoreAnswer→DecisionAnswer, DecisionResult; errors DecisionsDisabledError, DecisionGatewayUnreachableError, DecisionGatewayError.
- facade/api.py: decisions_enabled, decide (checks enrollment), decide_unchecked (operator tooling, e.g. management/commands/ml_inference_decide.py).
- logic/decisions.py: httpx gateway call, _wire_body, parse_result/_parse_answer, feature flag DECISIONS_FEATURE_FLAG, dark launch (DEBUG or US cloud).
- presentation/serializers.py: CriteriaField, DecisionQuestionSerializer, DecideRequestSerializer, DecideResponseSerializer.
- presentation/views.py: DecisionViewSet.decide; DecisionsDisabled→404, gateway not configured/unreachable→503, DecisionGatewayError→502 (logs status only, body may echo state).

search: ml_inference backend uses three-layer architecture (presentation → facade → logic) with tach exposing only facade.* and views.*; facade/contracts.py defines frozen pydantic dataclasses DecisionRequest (MAX_QUESTIONS_PER_REQUEST=32), DecisionQuestion (per-type criteria validation in __post_init__), and DecisionAnswer types. Gateway errors map to HTTP status codes: DecisionsDisabled→404, unreachable gateway→503, DecisionGatewayError→502 (body may echo state); feature flag DECISIONS_FEATURE_FLAG gates logic/decisions.py. Validation is duplicated across presentation/serializers.py and facade/contracts.py. Applies to decision API implementation, error handling paths, and validation constraints. Files: contracts.py, api.py, decisions.py, serializers.py, views.py; symbols: DecisionRequest, DecisionQuestion, decide, decide_unchecked, DecisionsDisabledError.
